sentences.text: For the school magazine, each student must show two looks made with the same main item. Nobody is asked to buy new clothes.

For the school magazine, each student must show two looks made with the same main item. Nobody is asked to buy new clothes.

Arpi chooses a plain waistcoat. For the first look, she wears it with a white blouse and formal trousers. For the second, she wears it over a striped T-shirt with jeans.

The magazine prints both pictures side by side. Readers are asked to notice what changes and what stays the same, rather than vote for the most expensive outfit.
